description:
Define the abstraction over "run one check's agent" — the seam that lets us swap `claude -p` for a Claude Code SDK (or other providers) later without touching execution. Per the spec it MUST be a boxed `#[async_trait]` trait object for dynamic dispatch, following the repo convention (`BoxedIngress`/`BoxedMonitor`/`BoxedPlatform`).
